_doc: Mapping between the source ComfyUI workflow 'Klein 完全体 / 三参考图全能王' LoRA stack and our local model dirs. Local dir name == swift `--lora <name>` value (Flux2LoRALoader.resolveFile picks the .safetensors inside models/lora/<name>/, preferring int8). Workflow provenance: https://www.runninghub.ai/zh-cn/post/2064189691808804865 (manual JSON export — RunningHub has no public download API; see docs/multi-reference-architecture.md).

_platform_caveats.negative_scale_unsupported: ComfyUI note: 'lora不支持负值' on this platform — negative-strength sliders (e.g. lips -2, chest -6) likely inert on MLX; needs empirical check.
_platform_caveats.bfs_darkbeast_unsupported_for_t2i: Workflow note: '这个平台可能不支持黑兽模型出图' — DarkKlein BFS is faceswap-only (see memory dark-beast-bfs-not-for-general-t2i). DarkKlein9b_v2BFS LoRA 0.25 is the faceswap lever, NOT general T2I.
_platform_caveats.key_format_silent_noop: BFL-only loader silently loads 0 adapters for WebUI-format LoRAs; patched variants (f2k_anything2real_a_patched) are pre-converted. swift loader warns on 0 adapters.
